name: Polynomial Regression
learningObjectives: Understand how polynomial features capture non-linear relationships
Learn to choose appropriate polynomial degrees
Recognize overfitting and underfitting in polynomial models
Apply feature normalization for polynomial regression
Interpret polynomial regression curves and coefficients

controls.label: Dataset
controls.tooltip: Choose a dataset to train on

controls.label: Polynomial Degree
controls.tooltip: Degree of the polynomial. Higher degrees can fit more complex curves but may overfit.

controls.label: Learning Rate
controls.tooltip: Controls how quickly the model learns.

visualizations.title: Data & Polynomial Curve
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing the data points and the fitted polynomial curve

visualizations.title: Training Loss
visualizations.description: Line chart showing how the loss decreases during training

metrics.name: Mean Squared Error
metrics.description: Average squared difference between predictions and actual values

metrics.name: Root Mean Squared Error
metrics.description: Square root of MSE, in the same units as the target

metrics.name: R² Score
metrics.description: Proportion of variance explained by the model (1.0 is perfect)

metrics.name: Mean Absolute Error
metrics.description: Average absolute difference between predictions and actual values

metrics.name: Polynomial Degree
metrics.description: The degree of the polynomial used in the model
